**Research notes (as of Monday, October 12, 2026):**

- The 24th and current prime minister of Canada is Mark Carney, who took office on 14 March 2025. (Wikipedia, List of prime ministers of Canada)
- Carney was sworn in on March 14, 2025, five days after he won the Liberal Party leadership election. (Wikipedia, Mark Carney)
- The prime minister's official website, pm.gc.ca, lists him as the current PM. Its homepage was updated within the last day. It shows news items dated October 13, 2026, including a call with India's prime minister and a Thanksgiving statement.
- Britannica says he became prime minister in March 2025 after the government of Justin Trudeau collapsed.
- Britannica also carries an AP headline dated Oct. 12, 2026. It describes Carney, as prime minister, making a case for Canadian unity as an Alberta referendum nears.
- The sources do not disagree. None of them mentions a change of prime minister.
